instruction.text: Lies dir die Sätze durch und tippe auf die beschriebene Position im Bild.

atoms.a: In the foreground, there is a meadow in which three cows are grazing.
One cow is standing in the front and is looking into the camera.
Behind the cows, there is a big single tree in the meadow.
In the upper part of the picture, there is a blue sky with some clouds. The sun is setting at the moment.
In the centre of the picture there is a mountain range, through which flows a river.

atoms.text: The picture “Celebration” was taken by Carina Lee in 2014 and shows a celebrating crowd. In the foreground as well as in the background, there are lots of people. Most of them are throwing their hands in the air as they are probably dancing. It seems as if they are reaching for something. The picture is taken from the perspective of someone who is taking part in the celebration. The viewer can see that the people in the foreground are sprinkled in different colours. The colours of the picture are bright and joyful, illustrating a vibrant atmosphere.

instruction.text: Welches Bild wurde beschrieben? Wähle aus.
Schaue dir das Bild an und vervollständige die Bildbeschreibung.

atoms.b: This picture shows a ((++winter autumn)) scene from New York Central Park.
((++In_the_foreground In_the_background)) there is a big ice rink where many people are ice skating.
((++In_the_background In_the_bottom_right-hand_corner)) there are big buildings and skyscrapers which are forming part of the urban skyline.
Some trees of Central Park establish an imaginary ((++border connection)) between the rink and the buildings.
The picture gives a ((++panoramic_view bird_perspective)) of the scene. The people appear rather small, although they are ((++closer more_distant)) to the viewer than the buildings.
The ((++sun_is_shining weather_is_bad)) on the buildings and people seem to be enjoying the experience. Although it seems to be ((++cold warm)), the atmosphere is pleasant.
